tei:div.tei:p: (za)༄༅// gzhi gsum gyi tshig gsal bar byed pa bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de'i zhabs kyi rdul phreng dri ma med pa la rnyog pa med pa'i mgo bos phyag 'tshal lo// thub bstan sprin dkar 'dzum pa'i khri stengs na// phan bde'i 'od zer stong phrag bzhad pa'i sku// rtag tu legs par gsung ba'i zhal mnga' ba// brtse chen smra ba'i nyi ma la phyag 'tshal// mchog tshogs 'dus pa'i yid bzhin mtsho 'gram der// thar pa'i gling du chas pa'i don mthun dag /rnam grol nor bu'i phreng ba len 'dod na// chos 'dul gru chen bzang po 'dir 'jug bya// zhes mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bcas nas/ legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba las byung ba'i lag len gyi cho ga nyer mkho bsdus pa 'di la don gsum ste/ sngon du 'gro ba gnas dang tshogs pa'i rnam gzhag dngos gzhi gzhi gsum gyi cho ga zhar la nye bar mkho ba'i lag len gzhan bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan dang ldan pa gnas mal gyi gzhi las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin/ dge 'dun gyi sde gnas pa'i gzhi gtsug lag khang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i dri gtsang khang gi dbus su/ seng ge'i khri bshams pa la ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de'i sku'i bkod pa ngo mtshar can mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus su bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ mtha' skor du nyan thos chen po rnams kyis legs par bskor te brjid chags par bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ me tog dang mar me la sogs pa'i phreng ba mtshar du dngar ba rgyun ma chad par bsham par bya'o// de'i sgo drung gi g.yon rol 'khor gyi khyams chen po'i gung la gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po 'dug pa'i seng ge khri gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas legs par brgyan par bya'o// 'khor gyi khyams der yang chag chag dang*/ phyag dar legs par byas shing rgyun du dri zhim po'i ngad dang ldan par bya'o// khyams de'i sgo khang gi steng gi yang thog tu rlung char la sogs pa'i gnod pa dang bral ba'i gnas su khri'u rgyan gyis spras pa la/

mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gaṇḍi g.yog dang bcas te bzhag par bya'o// de lta bu'i gtsug lag khang der bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i dge slong bzhi yan chad du longs pa dus rtag tu gnas pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya dgos te/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba nges par gnas pa la med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro// de'i nang nas gnas brtan nam shes rab gsal po dang ldan pa'i dge slong gang yang rung ba gcig gis 'dul ba 'dzin pa la 'bad par bya ste/ de med na las kyi cho ga rnams mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro// 'dul ba 'dzin pa de'i tshad kyang gang zhe na/ las brgya rtsa gcig pa las phran so so ba dang bcas pa rnams blo la thon par nus pa'o// mdor na dge tshul rkyang pa'i tshogs kyis mtshams nang gcig tu gnas par mi bya ste/ rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dag ni bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge 'dun gyis yongs su bzung ba tsam yin pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la/ dus gtan du dang 'brel ba gso sbyong gi cho ga dbyar gyi dus kho na dang 'brel ba dbyar gnas kyi cho ga dus nyi ma gcig dang 'brel yang dgos pas phal cher la khyab pa dgag dbye'i cho ga bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ nyi ma re re zhing bya ba rgyud chags gsum pa'i cho ga dus bzang po thams cad la bya ba mtshan thog thag tu chos nyan bshad kyi cho ga nya dang stong gi dus kho na la gtso bor bya ba gso sbyong gi cho ga'o// dang po la sbyor ba nyi ma bgrang zhing mdo 'don par skul ba/ dngos gzhi phyag 'tshal zhing mdo 'don pa/ mjug bsngo ba bya zhing gnyug mar gnas pa la gtor ma byin pa'o// dang po gnas brtan gyis skud pa la smin ma'i thur ma brgyus pa nyi ma re re zhing spo bas tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar ma chol bar bgrang bar bya'o// de yang rgyal la sogs pa'i zla ba drug gi mar ngo la nyin zhag bcu bzhi la tshes bco lnga tshang bar bgrang zhing*/

lhag ma rnams la ni nyin zhag bco lnga dang tshes bco lnga mnyam por bgrang bar bya'o// dge bskos kyis nyi ma re re zhing de la brtags nas dge 'dun la brjod cing mdo bskul bar bya'o// ji ltar zhe na/ stan bsham pa dang*/ gaṇḍi brdung ba dang*/ dris pa'i tshig gis lan yang dag par go bar byas nas/ dge 'dun tshogs pa na dge bskos kyis spyod lam 'greng*/ bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa/ mkhan po'am/ slob dpon nam/ gnas brtan pa'i zhal snga nas gtso mdzad dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng zla ba yar gyi ngo'i gral tshes gcig gam gnyis sam/ bco lnga pa mngon du gyur pa lags/ gtsug lag khang gi bdag po dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi lha rnams kyi slad du zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa re klag tu gsol zhes bskul bar bya'o// de nas dge 'dun rnams kyis rgyud chags gsum pa gdon bar bya ste/ gsum po gang zhe na/ dang por phyag 'tshal/ bar du mdo don/ tha mar bsod nams bsngo ba'o// dang po ni/ gnas brtan la sogs pa thams cad bzhengs te 'di skad ces/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i zhabs kyi rdul dri ma med pa la mgo bos rab tu gtugs te gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe// sa chen 'di la gom pa bdun bor nas// nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs// de tshe mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lhang nge ba// mgon po mchog brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal// gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum na mdzes// mnyam med mkhyen can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mi mchog 'dul ba kha lo bsgyur mdzad cing*// kun sbyor 'ching ba gcod mdzad de bzhin gshegs// dbang po zhi zhing nyer zhi zhi la mkhas// mnyan yod bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i gzhi// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// rgyas par spro na bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa yang bya'o// de nas mdo gdon par bya ste/

theg pa che chung gi mdo sde rgyas pa gang yang rung ba'am/ rgyas par mi nus na shin tu bsdus pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po tsam la bsten par bya zhing*/ mthar skar ma rab rib mar me dang*// sgyu ma zil pa chu bur dang*// rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bu// 'dus byas chos rnams de ltar blta// zhes dang*/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa// dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsung*// sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes gnas brtan gyis brjod do// gsum pa la/ bsngo ba dang*/ gtor ma btang ba'o// dang po ni/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// ces sogs dang*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman cig pu// zhes sogs dang*/ klu rgyal dga' bo nyer dga' bo// gzhan yang grong khyer gnas pa rnams// tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs// rtag tu bde ba thob par shog /ces brjod do// gnyis pa ni/ gtsug lag khang gi gzhi'i bdag po lha mo 'phrog ma la sogs pa rnams la rang rang gi cho gas gtor ma sbyin par bya zhing*/ 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// zhes sogs rkang pa bzhis smon lam gdab bo// gnyis pa dus bzang po rnams la bya ba'i cho ga bstan pa la/ dus bzang po ni gsum ste/ tshes brgyad dang*/ bcu bzhi dang*/ bco lnga'o// ci'i phyir zhe na/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams 'dzam bu'i gling du 'byung ba'i dus yin pa'i phyir ro// 'di la sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi/ 'jug dang gsum mo// dang po ni/ gong gi rgyud chags gsum pa zin pa'i de ma thag tu/ dge slong ngam dge tshul zhig gis sngar bzhin 'greng ba'i spyod lam gyis mtshan thog thag tu chos 'chad par nus pa'i dge slong zhig la 'di skad ces gsol ba gdab par bya ste/

bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba gsan du gsol/ de ring dus bzang po la bdag cag 'dir 'dus shing tshogs pa rnams la thugs brtse bas nye bar dgongs te mtshan thog thag tu chos nyan pa sbyin du gsol zhes brjod par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i dge slong des kyang spro zhing nus na/ theg pa che chung gi bka' dri ma med pa rgyas par bshad par bya zhing*/ gcig gis mi nus na mang po res kyis kyang bshad par bya'o// de tsam mi nus na/ mdor bsdus pa 'di tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ gang zhig gser mchog rang bzhin ri rab la gnas man dha ra dang lhar bcas gnod sbyin dang*// gdengs ka nor bu'i 'od kyi mun pa sel mdzad sa 'og gnas pa'i klu rnams gang yin dang*// gangs can rir ni dpal gyis rol zhing rab tu dga' ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa gang yin pa// de dag thams cad thar pa dam pa'i sgor gyur thub pa'i gsung mnyan phyir ni 'dir gshegs shig /lha dang lha min mi'am ci'i dbang po dang*// brgya byin la sogs chos kyi phyogs la bya ba byas pa rnams// sangs rgyas gsung rab rab tu zhi zhing bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa// 'di dag bshad kyis dam pa'i chos nyan phyir ni 'dir gshegs shig /gang dag phyogs bcu stong gi 'jig rten na// bde gshegs slob mar gyur pa gang su dag /deng 'dir ston pa chos kyi char 'bebs kyi// nyan par 'dod pa thams cad 'dir gshegs shig /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas byin gyis kun dga' rwa ba na dge slong brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/

dge slong dag shes pa ni 'grib/ srog ni chad/ tshe'i 'du byed ni 'dor/ ston pa'i bstan pa yang nges par 'jig par 'gyur bas/ ci'i phyir brtson 'grus dang rtul ba brtan pos sgrub par mi byed/ mi'i lus ni shin tu rnyed par dka' na/ de thob nas des rnyed pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba yang rnyed nas thar pa'i don dang mi mthun pa dag gis bslus te sdug bsngal bar gyur ta re/ dge slong dag srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni bla'i/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pa ni de lta ma yin no// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ srog dang bral zhing shi bas ni tshe 'di nyid kyi skye ba zad par 'gyur gyi/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pa ni skye ba 'bum phrag brgya'i bar du rigs dang bral zhing bde ba spangs te rnam par ltung ba chen po nyams su myong bar gyur ro// de phyir ston pas tshul khrims rab bsngags bshad// tshul khrims ldan pa sangs rgyas 'byung dang phrad// tshul khrims ldan pa rgyan rnams kun gyi mchog /tshul khrims ldan pa dri dang byug pa yin// tshul khrims ldan pa dga' ba kun gyi gnas// tshul khrims ldan pa gdung ba bsil ba'i chu// tshul khrims ldan pa 'jig rten kun gyis bstod// tshul khrims dag gis 'gro ba dam pa mnos// ji ltar sbrul gdug klu chen nag po yang*// tshul khrims ldan la gnod med gzhan ci smos// tshul khrims ldan pa'i dge slong 'od dang ldan// tshul khrims ldan pa grags 'gyur bde ba thob// ji ltar mig med gzugs mthong mi rung ltar// de bzhin tshul khrims med na chos mi mthong*// ji ltar rkang med lam 'jug ga la nus// de bzhin tshul khrims med na thar mi 'gyur// ji ltar bum pa bzang po rin chen snod// de bzhin tshul khrims chos rnams bskyed pa'i gzhi// ji ltar bum chag rin chen snod mi rung*// de bzhin tshul khrims ral bas chos kun gtugs// dang po tshul khrims med par gyur pa de// phyi nas mya ngan 'das pa thob snyam mam// sna med sna sdum la sogs gang yin pa// de la me long dag ni dgos mi 'gyur// rna bas ma thos mig sngar ma mthong yang*// bstan bsrung mi de mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur// thos mang thos ldan thos bsrung mtho ris nyid// bud med bsten du ga la rung*// rgyal po'i pho brang ga la dga'// longs spyod rtag pa ga la yod// bud med dag la rung ba med// rgyal srid dag la dga' ba med// lbu ba dag la snying po med// longs spyod dag la snying po med// longs spyod dag ni 'bab chu bzhin// gru de ci 'dra khyim de 'dra// me tog ci 'dra gzugs de bzhin// srog ni chu bur 'dra ba yin// bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/

nye bar 'khor la sogs pa'i dge slong de dag yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //gsum pa 'jug bsdu ba ni/ gal gzung ba dang gzhung gzugs la sogs 'bel ba'i gtam gyi sgo nas kyang rnam par gtan la dbab par bya zhing*/ 'di skad du/ chos bshad pa las byung ba yi// dge ba grub pa gang yod des// mar gyur 'gro ba thams cad kyang*// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ces bsngo ba bya'o// //gsum pa nya stong dang 'brel ba gso sbyong gi cho ga la/ spyir gso sbyong gi dbye ba/ dge tshul rnams kyis yongs su dag pa 'bul ba'i cho ga dge slong gi gso sbyong gi cho ga bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la/ spyir gso sbyong ni gnyis te/ dge bsnyen gyi dang*/ rab tu byung ba'i 'o// dang po ni dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang ldan pa'i khyim pas nyin zhag gcig gi mtha'i bar du gso sbyong blangs te/ yan lag brgya dang ldan par blang ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ lung na mi bzhugs kyang bstan bcos mkhan po'i 'dod pas bsgrubs pa dge tshul gyi gso sbyong dang*/ lung las gsungs pa dge slong gi gso sbyong ngo*// dang po la rang gi ngo bo ni/ dge slong zhig gi drung du rang rgyud la yod pa'i bshags bya'i nyes byas rnams phyir bcos byed pa de yin la/ 'di la dus kyi nges pa med cing*/ yongs dag 'bul ba ni/ dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams gso sbyong gang la bya ba'i nyi ma de nyid yin no// 'di la dge tshul gyi gso sbyong gi ming 'dogs pa ni bstan 'chos mdzad pa'i slob dpon shākya 'od dang*/ 'grel pa mkhan po chos bshes kyi lugs so// gnyis pa dge slong gi gso sbyong ni lnga ste/ bcu bzhi pa dang*/ bco lnga pa dang*/ mthun pa'i gso sbyong*/ gnod pa spang pa'i gso sbyong*/ bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong ngo*// dang po gnyis ni/ dus kyi khyad par tshes bco lnga la bya bas khyab la/

phyi ma gsum la ni dus kyis nges pa med do// gnyis pa dge tshul gyi gso sbyong gi cho ga la gnyis te/ dus nges med la bya ba bshags pa'i cho ga dang*/ dus nges pa can la bya ba yongs dag 'bul ba'i cho ga'o// dang po ni/ bshags bya'i nyes byas gang la byung ba'i dge tshul des/ nyes pa de byung ma thag tu dge slong gang yang rung ba zhig gi mdun du song ste/ 'di skad ces mkhan po'am slob dpon nam gnas brtan nam tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge tshul ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ bag ma mchis pa'i dbang gis myos par 'gyur ba 'thungs pa'i kha na ma tho ba lta bu 'di byung ste/ nyes pa de mkhan po'i drung du mthol lo// 'chags so// mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol zhing ma bshags na mi 'gyur ro// zhes lan gsum bzlas/ mthong sdom dris la thabs legs bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar nyes pa phyir bcos pas dag pa'am/ yang na nyes pas ma gos pa'i dge tshul gsum man chad dam/ tshogs su longs bas kyang rung ste/ dge slong zhig gi mdun du 'dug ste/ 'di skad ces gnas brtan nam/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol// deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag shākya'i dge tshul ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yang gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag shākya'i dge tshul mi 'di zhes bgyi ba bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag go zhes bdag mchi na/ bdag bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag par gnas brtan gyis bzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum bzlas la thabs legs bya'o// de brjod pa'i yul gyi dge slong de dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gral du nges par 'du ba zhig dgos la/ des dge 'dun la yongs dag brjod dgos pa ni ma yin te/ dge tshul rnams gso sbyong gi las de la mi dbang ba'i phyir ro// dge tshul gyi bshags pa dang yongs dag 'bul tshul de ltar ma grub pa/

dge tshul ji snyed pa dge 'dun gyi nang du song ste gnas brtan gyi drung du bshags pa byas te yongs su dag pa phul kyang legs par rung ba yin no// gsum pa dge slong gi cho ga bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum ste/ tshogs pa tshang pa'i tshe spyir btang gi gso sbyong ji ltar bya ba/ dge slong gnyis dang gsum las med pa'i tshe dmigs gsal gyi gso sbyong ji ltar bya ba/ rang gcig pus gso sbyong byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga'o// dang po la/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi/ 'jug gsum mo// dang po la gsum ste/ las gral la ma 'dus gong gi sbyor ba/ 'dus ma thag gi sbyor ba/ las kyi 'go brtsams pa nas bzung ba'i sbyor ba'o// dang po ni/ dge slong des gso sbyong la 'du ba'i gong rol du 'di ltar brtag par bya ste/ gso sbyong snga ma zin nas da lta'i bar nyes pa byung ngam ma byung*/ byung na ji lta bu zhig byung zhes brtags pa las nyes pas ma gos na de mchog yin la/ gos na ni bshags par 'os pa rnams bshags/ bsdam par 'os pa rnams bsdam/ byin gyis brlab par 'os pa rnams byin gyis brlabs zin pa zhig byas te 'dug par bya'o// de dag kyang gang zhe na/ nyi ma de nyid la las byed pa yin na/ dang po ni/ pham lhag gi sbom po lci yang gnyis dang*/ ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dang*/ so sor bshags pa dang*/ nyes byas kyi sde tshan rnams so// gnyis pa ni/ bsdam par byas pa'i nyes byas su bshad pa rnams so// gsum pa ni/ dge 'dun lhag ma dang*/ spang ba ltung byed rnams so// de yang 'di ltar ltung ba gang byung ba'i dge slong des ltung ba nang mi mthun pa'i dge slong zhig gi drung du phyin te/ mchil lh+wam phud/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos nas 'os la phyag bya ste/ dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ byis pa nyid dang*/ mi shes pa nyid dang ma gus pa dang*/ bag ma mchis pa dang*/

nyon mongs pa mang ba'i dbang gis ltung byed kyi sde tshan las/ shes bzhin brdzun du smra ba'i kha na ma tho ba lta bu 'di byung ste/ kha na ma tho ba de dag pa'i mtha' tshun chad nas bzung ste/ tshe dang ldan pa'i mdun du mthol lo// chags so// mthol zhing bshags na bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur la/ ma mthol ma bshags na mi 'gyur ro zhes lan gsum bzlas/ mthong sdom dri zhing thabs legs bya'o// de bzhin du pham par gtogs pa'i sbom po lci ba ni/ dge slong drug yan chad dang*/ yang ba ni dge slong bzhi yan chad dang*/ lhag mar gtogs pa'i sbom po lci ba ni/ dge slong lnga yan chad dang*/ yang ba ni dge slong gcig gi mdun du bshags pa'i tshig ni snga ma kho na bzhin du bya'o// gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ltung ba mi mthun pa'i dge slong gcig gi mdun du song ste/ tshig snga ma bzhin du sbyar nas zhes bgyi ba la/ dge 'dun lhag ma'i sde tshan las reg pa'i lhag ma dang*/ spang ba ltung byed kyi sde tshan las/ gos zhag bcu 'chang ba'i spang ltung 'di byung ste/ ltung ba de tshe dang ldan pa'i mdun du byin gyis brlab bo// deng ltung ba de byin gyis brlabs te/ dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong mdzad la/ slad kyis ltung ba de chos bzhin du slar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum bzlas la thabs legs bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ las gral du 'dug ma thag tu ltung ba dran nam/ yid gnyis za na/ drung na mo la byin gyis brlab pa'i tshul snga ma bzhin no// las byed pas ni dran nam yid gnyis za na/ rang gcig pus sems kyis byin gyis brlab par bya'o// sbyor ba'i cho ga 'di yan chad ni gal che shos yin pas/ las gral la ma 'dus pa'i gong du nges par byas la/ der ma grub na gnas khang gcig tu tshogs nas byas kyang nyes pa med de/ ltung ba thun mong ba byin gyis brlab pa dang rigs pa mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'dus nas ji ltar bya ba la/

rgyud dag par sgrub pa gnas la blo mthun bya ba/ dge 'dun mthun pa bsgrub cing nad pa sogs kyi gso sbyong nyams su myong bar bya ba'o// dang po ni/ mtshams nang de na yod pa'i dge slong thams cad ltung ba mthun par gyur nas bshags yul ma rnyed na thun mong ba byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ de'i sngags ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong lags la/ bdag cag dge 'dun thams cad ni ltung ba dang bcas par gyur na/ gang gi mdun du bdag cag ltung ba de chos bzhin du slar bgyi ba/ bdag cag las dge slong gnas gzhan du mchis la/ dge slong gi mdun du ltung ba chos bzhin du slar bgyid par spro bas su yang ma mchis na gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyis deng ltung ba byin gyis brlabs te/ gso sbyong mdzad la slad kyi dge slong gi mdun du ltung ba de dag chos bzhin du slar mdzad do// 'di ni gsol ba'o// de yan chad ni gso sbyong kho nar ma zad kyi/ ltung ba can dge 'dun gyi las la 'jug pa thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba yin la/ ltung bas ma gos pa rnams la ni 'di yan chad kyi sngon 'gro rnams mi dgos so// gnyis pa gnas la blo mthun par bya ba ni/ gso sbyong gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro yin pas gso sbyong gi gzhi'i thog ma ni 'di nas bzung bar bya'o// de yang las byed pas thog mar gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu zhes brjod la/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad grub pa'am bgyis lags pa nang mtshams dang*/ phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di/ dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bzhed na/ gal te dge 'dun rnams kyis dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyi gnas thams cad grub pa'am/

bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang*/ phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di/ dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi'o// 'di ni gsol ba'o// brjod pa 'jug bsdud dang bcas pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad grub pa'am bgyis pa lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di/ dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag gnas thams cad nas/ 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung cig gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyi gnas thams cad nas bcas pa 'di/ dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyis lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to zhes brjod do// sbyor chog gsum pa la/ so so thar pa'i mdo yi che ba brjod pa/ 'dun pa dang yongs su dag pa blangs nas brjod pa/ gsol ba dang rnam par bzhag pa 'dzin du gzhug pa sngar bya ba rnams so// dang po ni/ gnas brtan gyis 'di skad ces/ so so thar pa'i mdo la ston pa'i 'du shes/ rang nyid bslab pa la gces spras su byed pa'i 'du shes/ chos kyi tshul 'di la brten nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes te/ de ltar thugs la bzhag nas/ thams cad kyis gsan pa zhu zhes brjod la/ thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// snyan pa'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum du grags// dam pa'i chos sgra seng ge'i sgra sgrags pa// thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog mdzod brnyes pa// zhabs la tshangs dbang gtsug gi nor bus gtugs// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho gting mtha' med brgal ba// 'gro ba'i gtso la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te// thams cad mkhyen pa'i bslab gzhi dkon mchog snod// 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi dbus su dbye bar bya// sangs rgyas 'dul ba gangs chen mtsho// gting mtha' med pa thams cad kyi// gnas pa'i snying dang snying po ni// so so thar pa 'di yin no// 'di ni dam chos rgyal po yi// chos kun gyi ni 'dren pa'i mchog

/'di ni dge slong tshong tshogs kyi// bslab zong tshong khang chen po yin// tshul khrims 'chal pas zin rnams kyi// gdug pa sel ba'i sman 'di yin// 'di ni lang tsho rnam 'phrul ba'i// rkang gnyis gzhon nu'i lcags kyu yin// mtsho bas zab pa'i 'khor ba las// sgrol ba'i brgal thabs 'di yin te// 'di ni bzang 'gror 'gro ba yi// nges pa'i chu lon zam pa yin// 'di ni nyon mongs pham byed lam// rgyal po yi ni 'dren pa mchog /'di ni thar pa'i grong 'jug pa'i// them skas bzhi dang 'dra bar gnas// nga ni mya ngan 'das gyur na// 'di ni khyed kyi ston pa zhes// rang byung nyid kyis gus bcas par// nan tan dge slong tshogs mdun bstod// sangs rgyas shes bya'i sgra 'di yang*// 'jig rten dag na rab tu dkon// mi nyid rnyed pa shin tu dka'// rab tu byung ba shin du dkon// de bzhin rab tu byung rnams kyi// tshul khrims phun sum tshogs rab dkon// tshul khrims yongs su dag gyur kyang*// grogs bzang shin tu rnyed pa dka'// 'jig rten sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang*// mi dang rab tu byung ba dang*// tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa dang*// grogs bzang rnyed dka' rnyed gyur nas// mkhas pa dag la legs 'dod cing*// de dag 'bras bcas byed 'dod pa// sdom brtson rnams kyi so sor thar// mnyan pa'i phyir ni 'bad par bya// dge slong dbang dul kun dbang po// sangs rgyas mi 'gyur rab byung ba// nges par thar bar 'dod rnams kyis// so sor thar pa rtag tu bsrungs// bskal pa bye ba rnams su yang*// so sor thar pa thos pa dang*// bzung dang 'dzin pa rnyed dka' ste// sgrub pa'ang shin tu rnyed par dka'// sangs rgyas rnams ni 'byung ba bde// chos bstan pa yang bde ba yin// dge 'dun mthun pa bde ba de// mthun pa rnams kyi dka' thub bde// 'phags pa rnams ni mthong ba bde// dam pa dag dang 'grogs pa bde// byis pa rnams ni ma mthong na// rtag tu bde ba nyid du 'gyur// tshul khrims ldan pa mthong ba bde// mang du thos pa mthong ba bde// yang srid rnam par grol ba yi// dgra bcom pa dang mthong ba bde// 'jug ngogs bde ba'i chu klung bde// chos la goms pa'i skye bo bde// shes rab thob par gyur pa bde// nga 'ong nga rgyal zad pa bde// nges par byas shing dbang po dul ba dag

/dgon pa zhi ba rnams su rgas gyur kyang*// mang du thos pa nags kyi nang dag tu// lang tsho yol ba rnams kyis gnas pa bde// tshe dang ldan pa dag so ka rnams kyi 'das pa dang*// lhag ma ji tsam pa de tsam mo// tshe dang ldan pa dag rga ba dang 'chi ba mngon par 'ong zhing ston pa'i bstan pa yang 'jig par 'gyur bas/ tshe dang ldan pa dag gis bag yod pa rnal 'byor du bya'o// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub dang*/ gzhan yang gang dag de lta bu dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi phyogs rnams kyang bag yod pas thob bo// bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni don nyung ba bya ba nyung ba yin la/ dge 'dun gyis thog mar bya ba ci yod/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ma lhags pa rnams la 'dun pa dang yongs su dag pa dris shig dris nas kyang brjod par bya'o// zhes gnas brtan gyi brjod ma thag tu dge skos kyis tshul shing brim pas dge slong rnams bgrang bar bya zhing*/ ma tshang na ma lhags pa rnams la 'dun pa yongs su dag par dri bar bya zhing*/ dris nas kyang brjod par bya'o// de 'bul ba'i sngags ni/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag dge slong bro tshal ba/ sdug bsngal ba/ bro tshabs che ba/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yang gso sbyong bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag go zhes bdag mchi'o// dge 'dun chos bzhin du mdzad pa la 'dun pa 'bul lo// bdag gi gso sbyong yang yongs su dag go /'dun pa yongs su dag pa yang brjod do// brjod pa yang rig par bgyid do// zhes lan gsum brjod de/ de nas len pa pos dge 'dun la brjod pa ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bco lnga pa lags la/ gnas che ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba/

ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yang gso sbyong bco lnga pa lags/ dge slong bro 'tshal ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag go zhes kho na nyid mchi'o// dge 'dun chos bzhin mdzad pa la 'dun pa 'bul lo// de'i gso sbyong yang yongs su dag go /'dun pa dang yongs su dag pa yang dag brjod do// brjod pa yang rig par bgyi'o// zhes lan cig brjod do// de nas gnas brtan gyis 'di skad ces/ shākya seng ge de la ni// sor mo bcu yis thal sbyar te// so sor thar pa gdon par bya// gdul ba'i don du nga las nyon// thos na drang srong chen po yis// ji skad gsung zhing bsgrub bya zhing*// kha na ma tho phra rnams la// rtun cing byed pa nyid du gyis// rtag tu 'bad pas 'da' ba yis// sems rta kha blan dka' ba la// mthun pa gzer rnon rgyab pa yi// srab ni so sor thar 'di yin// che ba gang dag dag tsam gyis// ldog cing mtshams las mi 'da' ba// de dag mi rta bzang po ste// nyon mongs g.yul las nges rgyal 'gyur// su la sra ba 'di med pa dang*// nam du 'di 'dod par mi 'gyur ba// de dag nyon mongs g.yul gyis dkrugs// 'jog bral rnam par 'khyam par 'gyur// dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol// deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am bco lnga pa lags te/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ deng dge 'dun gso sbyong mdzad de/ so sor thar pa'i mdo gdon par gdon to/ 'di ni gsol ba'o// gnyis pa rnam par bzhag pa 'dzin du gzhug pa ni tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag gso sbyong bya ste/ so sor thar pa'i mdo gdon pa gdon gyi/ khyed cag su la ltung ba yod pa des mthol cig ltung ba med na cang ma smra cig cang mi smra na bdag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag yongs su dag par rig par bya'o// de ltar so sor dris nas dge slong gis lan btab pa de bzhin du/

dge slong gi 'khor 'di lta bur yang lan gsum gyi bar du bsgrags par bya ba yin no// yang dge slong gang dge slong gi 'khor 'di lta bur lan gsum gyi bar du bsgrags pa na ltung ba yod la dran bzhin du mi mthol na de shes bzhin du brdzun du smra ba yin no// tshe dang ldan pa dag shes bzhin du brdzun du smra ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bar du gcod pa'i chos su gsungs so// de bas na dge slong ltung ba byung ba rnam par dag par 'dod pas/ ltung ba yod la dran zhing mthong ba mthol bar bya'o// mthol na ni bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur ro// ma mthol ma bshags na ni mi 'gyur ro// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ so so thar pa'i mdo gdon pa rnam pa lnga ste/ gleng gzhi gdon pa/ pham pa gdon pa/ lhag ma gdon pa/ ma nges pa gdon pa/ ril gyis gdon pa rnams so// dang po ni sngar gdon zin pa la bsnyan pa'i tshul gyis 'di skad ces/ tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag gis so so thar pa'i mdo gdon pa'i gleng gzhi bton zin to// de la bdag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag la/ ci 'di la khyed yongs su dag gam zhes dri'o// ci 'di la khyed yongs su dag gam zhes lan gnyis lan gsum du dri'o// 'di la tshe dang ldan pa dag yongs su dag na/ 'di ltar cing mi smra bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to/ gdon pa gnyis pa ni/ sdom la/ mi tshangs spyod dang brku ba dang*// mi la bsad par mi bya ba// brdzun du smra dang bcas pa yi// chos bzhi 'dir ni gsungs pa yin// tshe dang ldan pa dag pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi po 'di dag ni/ zla ba phyed phyed cing so so thar pa'i mdo gdon pa las 'byung ngo*// yang dge slong gang dge slong rnams dang lhan cig bslab pa mtshungs par gyur pas bslab pa ma phul bslab pa nyams par ma byas par/ mi tshangs par spyod pa 'khrig pa las byung ba'i chos bsten na/ tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa dang lhan cig kyang rung ste/

dge slong de pham par gyur pa yin gyis/ gnas par mi bya'o// yang dge slong gang gzhan gyi grong na 'dug pa'am/ dgon pa na 'dug pa ma byin par len pa brku ba'i grangs su gtogs pa blangs na/ ji tsam ma byin par blangs pas/ de rgyal po'am/ blon po chen pos bzung nas/ de la 'di skad ces/ kye mi khyod ni rkun ma'o// byis pa'o// blun pa'o// brku ba'o zhes zer zhing*/ gsod dam/ 'ching ngam/ spyugs kyang rung ste/ dge slong de ltar ma byin par len na/ dge slong de yang pham par gyur pa yin gyi gnas par mi bya'o// yang dge slong gang mir chags pa bsam bzhin du rang gis lag bdar te srog bcad dam/ de la mtshon byin nam/ de la mtshon thogs pa gnyer tam/ de 'chir bcug gam/ de la 'chi ba'i bsngags pa brjod kyang rung ste/ de la 'di skad ces/ kye mi khyod 'tsho ba sdig pa mi gtsang ba ngan pa 'dis ci zhig bya/ kye mi khyod gson pa bas shi ba bla'o zhes zer zhing*/ sems kyi 'dod pa/ sems kyi kun tu rtog pa dag gis rnam grangs du ma dag gis de 'chir bcug gam/ de la 'chi ba'i bsngags pa brjod de/ de yang rtsom pa des dus byas na/ dge slong de yang pham par gyur pa yin gyi gnas par mi bya'o// yang dge slong gang mngon par mi shes shing*/ yongs su mi shes la mi'i chos bla ma mtha' dang*/ 'phags pa dang bye brag phyed pa dang*/ shes pa dang*/ mthong ba dang*/ reg par spyod pa med pa/ med bzhin du 'di shes so// 'di mthong ngo zhes khas 'ches pa las/ de ltung ba byung ba de rnam par dag 'dod nas/ dus gzhan zhig na dris kyang rung*/ ma dris kyang rung*/ 'di skad ces tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag gis ni/ mi shes par shes so zhes smras/ ma mthong bar mthong ngo zhes smras te/ gsob gsog brdzun du smras so zhes zer na/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal ma gtogs te dge slong de yang pham par gyur pa yin gyi gnas par mi bya'o// tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag gis pham par gyur pa'i chos bzhi po dag bton zin to// dge slong dag gis de dag las ltung ba gang yang rung ba zhig byas na/

thog ma ji lta bar phyis kyang de bzhin pham par gyur pa yin te/ dge slong rnams dang lhan cig gnas pa dang longs spyod du mi dbang gi gnas par mi bya'o// de la bdag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag la ci 'di la khyed yongs su dag gam zhes dri'o// ci 'di la khyed yongs su dag gam zhes lan gnyis lan gsum dri'o// 'di la tshe dang ldan pa dag yongs su dag na 'di ltar cang mi smra ba de de bzhin du 'dzin to// lhag ma rnams ni thos pa bsgrags pas kyang rung bas/ 'di skad ces/ tshe dang ldan pa dag slad ma pham par 'gyur ba chos bzhi dang*/ dge 'dun lhag ma'i chos bcu gsum dang*/ ma nges pa gnyis dang*/ spang ba ltung byed sum cu dang*/ 'ba' zhig pa dang dgu bcu dang*/ so sor bshags par bya ba bzhi dang*/ bslab par bya ba'i chos mang po dang*/ rtsod pa zhi bar bya ba'i chos bdun po rnams ni zla ba phyed phyed cing so so thar pa'i mdo gdon pa las 'byung bas/ sngar gsan pa'am phyis kyang gsan par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod par bya'o// gsum pa 'jug ni/ so sor thar pa ston pa yis// bsod nams grub pa gang yod pa// des ni 'jig rten ma lus pa// thub dbang go 'phang thob par shog /brtsam pa bya zhing dbyung bar bya// sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya// 'dam pa'i khyim la glang chen bzhin// 'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya// gang zhig rab tu bag yod par// chos 'dul 'di la spyod gyur pa// skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs te// sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur// phan tshun tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*// bstan pa 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir// so so thar pa 'di bton pas// dge 'dun gyis ni gso sbyong byas// gang gi phyir ni mdo bton dang*// gang phyir gso sbyong byas gyur pa// tshul khrims de ni bsrung byas te// g.yag rnga'i rtse mo ji bzhin no// zhes brjod do// gnyis pa dmigs bsal gyi gso sbyong ni/

gso sbyong gi nyin bzhir ma tshang na dus kyi bar du bsdad la/ des kyang ma tshang na/ mchod pa bshams la gcig gi mdun du gcig 'dug ste/ 'di skad ces btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag go zhes bdag mchi na/ bdag yongs su dag par btsun pas bzung du gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba/ tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ deng gso sbyong byin gyis brlab bo// gang gi tshe dge 'dun tshogs pa rnyed pa de'i tshe dge 'dun dang lhan cig gso sbyong rgya cher nyams su myong bar bya zhing*/ so so thar pa'i mdo gdon pa yang gdon par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ thabs legs bya'o// gsum pa gcig pus byin gyis rlob pa ni lha rnams dgongs su gsol zhes dang*/ mthar lha rnams kyis bzung du gsol zhes brje ba ma gtogs snga ma bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o// ding sang 'di na gso sbyong gi /lag len cho ga shin tu 'khrul// mdo lung ji bzhin ma 'khrul bar// ji bzhin bshad 'di dang du long*// gso sbyong gi cho ga bstan zin to// //gnyis pa dbyar gyi gzhi'i cho ga la gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi/ dmigs bsal gyi cho ga'o// dang po la gnyis te/ ring ba'i sbyor ba dang*/ nye ba'i sbyor ba'o// dang po ni/ zla ba phyed tsam gyi snga rol nas gtsug lag khang gi byi dor bya ba dang*/ sbyin bdag dang zhal lta ba dang*/ spyod yul gyi grong dang*/ bsod snyoms dang*/ sman sbyin par byed pa dang*/ gnas kyi bla ma yod pa dang*/ thab bkrol can med cing mi 'byung ba dang*/ mdor na zla ba gsum du gnas pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i sta gon bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ gnas khang dang*/ gnas mal dang*/ khri'u dang*/ chol zangs sogs tshang bar sta gon bya zhing*/ de stobs pa'i dge slong gcig gam du ma bsko bar bya'o// de'i sngags ni/

las byed pas dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba khyod dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stob par spro'am zhes dri/ spro zhes zer na las byed pas dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stob par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ gnas mal stob par bskos te/ gnas mal stob pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stobs so// 'di ni gsol ba'o// las ni 'di ltar bya ste/ dge 'dun nas gsol/ dge slong nas spro ste/ de'i slad du nas bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong mi 'di zhes bgyi ba/ gnas mal stob par bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung shig gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig ces lan gcig go /mjug bsdud ni/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ gnas mal stob par bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to zhes brjod do// bskos pa'i dge slong des tshul shing srid du khru gang ba/ ya yo dang khyar khyor dang bcas bcus med pa/ kha dog bzang ba/ dri zhim pa/ reg na 'jam pa rnams sta gon byas la/ gzeb kyi srog mar ras dkar po bting ba dkris pa rgan pa'i mthar bzhag la/ rang nyid 'dud pa dang bcas pas 'greng ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bkra shis kyi gtsug lag khang che mo zhes bya ba 'di na/ khrims su bya ba dbyar dge 'dun gyi nang du 'khrug long gi rgyu bzhi po gang rung gi sgo nas 'khrug long mi skyed pa 'di dang*/ gnas ral ba dang*/ grums pa bcos pa dang*/ byin gyis ma brlabs par mtshams kyi phyi rol du skya rengs 'char bar mi bya ba zhes bya ba 'di yod de/ khyed cag las gang khrims su bya ba 'di dang 'dis/

gnas 'dir gnas par spro ba de tshul shing long zhig khyed cag las sus kyang dbyar dge 'dun gyi nang du 'khrug long bskyed par mi bya'o// khyed cag las gang gis 'ga' zhig la cung zad shes pa des da smros shig khyed cag las gang dbyar gyi nang du dge 'dun las 'khrug long bskyed par gyur pa de la/ dge 'dun gyis phyis nye bar brtag par dgongs so// zhes khrims su bya ba brjod do// de nas tshul shing blang ba dang dbyar gnas pa khas blang ba'i phyir/ dge 'dun rnams gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las kyis thugs bstun par bya ste/ las byed pa pos 'di skad ces/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dbyar nye bar sgrub pa dbyar zla 'bring po'am tha chung gi tshes bco lnga lags na/ gal te dge 'dun gyi dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ deng dge 'dun gyis tshul shing bzhengs te/ sang nang par dbyar gnas pa khas blang ngo*// 'di ni gsol ba'o zhes brjod do// de nas gnas mal stob pa la bskos pa de tshul shing brim par bya ste/ dang por ston pa'i tshul shing gcig dbul/ de'i 'og tu gnas brtan nas rim par brims te/ dge tshul rnams kyis ni rang rang gi mkhan po dang slob dpon len du gzhug brims zin pa dang dal bus 'jog tu bcug ste/ 'jug tu gnyug mar gnas pa'i tshul shing gcig gnas brtan gyis blangs/ rjes su brim pa pos spyod lam 'greng*/ thal mo sbyar/ dge 'dun nas gsol gnas 'dir dge slong 'di snyed kyis tshul shing blangs so// zhes go bar bya'o// de'i 'og tu gnas khang dang gnas mal rnams stabs par bya ste/ dang por gnas brtan gyis gnas khang gi lde mig dang sgo lcags bzung nas/ de'i mdun du 'dug ste/ gnas brtan gtsug lag khang 'di ni rnyed pa dang bcas pa/ gos kyi rin dang bcas pa lags kyi/ bzhes shig ces dge tshul gyi mtha'i bar du yang de bzhin no// de gnas mal yang rim pa bzhin du brims pa'i rjes kho nar stobs pa pos/

dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ khyed cag las gang gis kyang dge 'dun gyi gnas mal la gding ba med par longs spyad par mi bya/ gding ba rung ba ma yin pas longs spyad par mi bya/ gding ba dri ma can gyis longs spyad par mi bya'o// zhes go bar bya zhing*/ dge 'dun bsang sbyin bdag che ge dang*/ zhal lta ba che ge mo dang*/ spyod yul gyi grong che ge mo dang*/ nad g.yog che ge mos gnas par zhal gyis bzhes par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod do// de dag ni tshes bco lnga la bya ba'i sbyor ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ tshes bcu drug gi nyin rang rang so so'i gnas steng g.yogs dang bcas par/ dge 'dun du ma longs pa'i dge slong gi drung du tsog tsog pur 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba nang mtshams dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir/ 'di lta ste/ gnas ral pa dang*/ 'grums pa bcos pa'i slad du sbyin bdag la sogs pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum gnas par khas blang ngo*// bdag dbyar 'di na mchis shing*/ bdag gi dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags so// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ thabs legs bya'o// yang na dbyar phyi ma zhes so 'di gang zag gi las yin pas gsum man chad kyi grangs nges pa mi dgos so// gsum pa dmigs bsal gyi cho ga la/ zhag bdun rgyu bar byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga dang*/ zhag bzhi bcu pa'i gnang ba thob pas zhag brgyad nas bzhi bcu'i bar byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga'o// dang po ni/ mtshams kyi nang kho nar dge slong chos dgu ldan gyi drung du/ tsog pur 'dug ste/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ mtshams nang dang bcas pa'i gnas 'di dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum gnas pa las/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba bgyi ba zhig gi slad du/ dgung bdun mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang*/ de tshun chad kyi slar mchi bar byin gyis brlab bo// bdag dbyar 'di na mchis shing*/

bdag gi dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags so// zhes lan gsum brjod/ thabs legs bya/ zhag gcig dang gnyis la sogs pa la yang de bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ gnang ba 'di 'chags pa dge 'dun gyi don yin pa zhig dgos pas/ 'di ltar las byed pa/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod dge 'dun gyi ched du zhag bzhi bcu byin gyis brlabs te/ mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'gro bar spro'am/ spro'o// de nas dge 'dun la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba gsol ba'i phyir/ phyag gsum bya ste/ rgan pa'i mthar tsog pur 'dug ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ nang mtshams dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum gnas par khas blangs te/ bdag dbyar 'di na mchi zhing*/ bdag gi dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags pa las/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ zhag bzhi bcu byin gyis brlabs te/ dge 'dun gyi ched du mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang*/ de tshun chad kyi slar mchi bar spro na/ thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse bas nye bar bzung ste/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsal du gsol zhes lan gsum brjod do// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i don sbyin pa la gnyis te/ zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba byin pa dang*/ de thob nas byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga'o// dang po ni dge 'dun nas gsol dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ nang mtshams kyi nas khas blangs te/ 'di dbyar 'di na gnas lags pa las/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ dge 'dun gyi ched du mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang*/ de tshun chad kyis slar mchi bar dge 'dun la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab na mdzod cig dang*/ 'di dbyar 'di na mchi zhing gnas pa lags pa las/ dge 'dun gyi ched la/ mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang*/

de tshun chad kyis slar mchi bar dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ dge 'dun gyi zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsol to// 'di ni gsol ba'o// las ni dge 'dun nas gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ mtshams kyi gnas 'di lags pa las/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ dge 'dun gyi ched lags la/ slar mchi bar dge 'dun la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba gsol to// de'i slad du 'di dbyar 'di na mchis shing*/ 'di'i dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags pa las/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi ched lags na/ slar mchi bar dge 'dun gyis zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsol na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsal bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung zhig ces lan cig dang mjug bsdud brjod do// gnyis pa de ltar gnang ba thob pa des kyang mtshams kyi phyi rol du nam 'gro ba'i tshe/ zhag brgyad nas bzhi bcu'i bar gang dgos pa de byin gyis brlob pas/ de'i sngags ni/ sngar gyi zhag bdun byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho ga de nyid 'don pa bsgyur bar bya'o// dbyar gnas pa'i cho ga'o// gsum pa dgag dbye'i cho ga la/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes gsum mo// dang po la/ ring ba'i sbyor ba dang*/ nye ba'i sbyor ba'o// dang po ni/ spyod yul brjod pa nas seng ge'i khri brgyan pa'i bar dang*/ nang dang bcas pa la bzod par gsol ba sogs tshes brgyad nas bcu bzhi'i bar yan chad la zin par byas la/ tshes bcu bzhi dang bco lnga'i nyin mtshan gnyis ka chos rnam par gtan la dbab par bya zhing*/ dgag dbye'i dngos gzhi'i las ni/ tshes bcu drug gi skya rengs 'char ka tshun la zin par bya'o// gnyis pa la/ dge 'dun mthun pa sgrub rgyud dag par bya ba dgag dbye byed pa po bsko ba'o// dang po ni/ mtshams nang de na yod cing*/ na ba la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis las kyi gnas su 'du bar ma nus na/

'dun pa dang dgag dbye dbul ba'i cho ga ni snga ma bzhin no// mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ yongs su dag pa 'bul ba'i tshab tu 'di skad ces/ bdag la mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyi'o// 'dun pa dang dgag dbye yang brjod do// brjod par yang rig par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum bzla zhing brjod pa'i tshe yang de skad do// sbyor chog gnyis pa ni/ snga ma gso sbyong gi skabs bzhin no// gsum pa la/ byed pa po bsko ba dang*/ dge 'dun thugs bstun pa'o// dang po ni/ las byed pas 'di skad ces/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod/ dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye byed par spro'am/ spro'o// dge 'dun nas gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba nas spro na gal te nas mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ dgag dbye byed par bskos te/ dge slong dgag dbye bgyid pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid par 'gyur ro// 'di ni gsol ba'o// las ni dge 'dun nas gsol/ dge slong nas spro ste/ de'i slad du nas bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag nas cang ma gsung zhig gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig ces brjod pa gcig dang mjug sdud brjod do// gnyis pa ni/ dge 'dun nas gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags te/ gal te nas mdzod cig dang*/ deng dge 'dun dgag dbye mdzad do// 'di ni gsol ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ spyir btang ba'i dgag dbye dang*/ dmigs kyis bsal ba'i dgag dbye'o// dang po ni/ bskos pa des rtswa dur bha dge 'dun thams cad la khyab par 'brim mo// rtswa de yul rten gnyis ka'i lag pas phan tshun nas bzung ste/ dgag dbye byed pa po'i mdun du tsog pur 'dug la/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/

deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yang dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags na/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bdag la mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid kyi/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la gdams su gsol/ rnams kyis bdag la rjes su bstan du gsol/ rnams kyis bdag la rjes su bzung du gsol/ thugs brtse ba can tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ ltung ba shes bzhin mthong na chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin slar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ thabs legs bya'o// de nas byed pa po des kyang gzhan gyi drung du dgag dbye bya'o// gsum pa 'jug ni/ byed pa pos rtswa'i chun po rnams bsdus te/ 'di skad ces/ gnas 'dir dbyar gnas pa'i dge slong 'di snyed kyis dgag dbye mdzad do zhes go bar byas pa'i rjes la/ gral la 'khod pa rnams kyis legs par dgag dbye mdzad do// shin tu dgag dbye mdzad do zhes go bar bya'o// de nas bskos pa des dang rdzas khab yan chad lag tu thogs te btsun pa rdzas 'di lta bus kyang dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyir rung ngo zhes brjod cing*/ de'i 'og tu dge tshul rnams kyi dgag dbye bya'o// gnyis pa dmigs bsal gyi dgag dbye ni/ dge slong re re ba dag gnas par mi nus na tshogs kyi dgag dbye go bar bya ba dang*/ dge slong 'thab bkrol can 'ong ba thos pa'am/ dbyar gyi nang du chos ldan gyi bya bas 'gro dgos na/ gso sbyong gnyis sam gsum thal nas dus nya shi cig dang bstun nas dgag dbye bya ba rnams dang*/ dbyar byin gyis brlabs te song bas gtsug lag khang gzhan du dgag dbye byas pas go chod pa rnams so// khyad par tshogs kyi dgag dbye ni/ mig lam du gang byung ba'i dge slong zhig gi drung du dgongs su gsol/

deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye lags la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i dgag dbye lags na/ zhes snga ma kho na bzhin du sbyar ro// de nas gnas la lhag par chags pa spang ba'i phyir/ tshes bcu drug gi nyin par rgyang grags cig gi bar du ljongs rgyu zhing 'gro bar gsungs so// gsum pa nye bar mkho ba'i lag len gzhan bstan pa ni/ gos dang*/ sman dang*/ lhung bzed dang*/ rin po che byin gyis brlab pa'o// dang po ni/ 'os la phyag byas te/ gnas brtan dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gos bgyi lags pa/ rung ba spyad par 'os pa 'di chos gos snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab bo zhes lan gsum brjod la/ thabs legs bya'o// yo byad bcu gsum po gzhan la'ang de bzhin no// lhag pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ snam sbyar la sogs pa lhag po rnams snga ma bzhin du bzung la/ dgongs su gsol/ zhes bgyi ba'i gos lhag po rung ba ma bgyis pa rung ba bgyi bar 'os pa 'di mkhan po'i legs par rung bar bgyi'o// mkhan po la yid gtad de bcang bar bgyi'o// rkyen ji lta ba ji bzhin du bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum dang thabs legs bya'o// mkho ba'i yo byad du byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ gos kyi khyad par khru gang yan chad bzung ste/ dgongs su gsol/ gos 'di bdag dang tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa la mkho ba'i yo byad kyi gos su byin gyis brlab bo zhes lan gsum dang*/ thabs legs bya'o// yul med pa'i tshe rang gcig pus dngos po de bzung nas byin gyis brlab pa chags so// dbyung ba la ni dngos po med pa dang rang cig pus kyang rung la/ yul yod pa'i tshe btsun pa nas zhes bgyi ba'i gos bgyis pa sogs 'di/ chos gos snam sbyar du byin gyis brlabs pa las/ de lta bas na dngos po de slar dbyung bar bgyi'o zhes lan gsum dang*/ thabs legs bya'o// gzhan la'ang de bzhin du sbyar zhing*/

lhag pa'i yo byad sogs gnyis la/ byin brlabs dbyung mi dgos so// lhung bzed byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yul rten gnyis ka 'greng*/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du gzhag g.yas pas kha bkab la/ btsun pa sogs nas/ zhes bgyi ba'i lhung bzed zas la spyad par 'os pa/ drang srong gi snod 'di blang ba'i snod du byin gyis brlab bo zhes lan gsum dang*/ thabs legs bya'o// dbyung ba la ni lag pa ya res bzung bas chog go /sman byin gyis brlob pa ni/ sman yongs su rdzogs pa byin len can gnyis ka'i mdun du bzhag la/ btsun pa sogs nas zhes bgyi ba'i btung ba 'di thun tshod du rung bar byin gyis brlab pa'o// zhes dang*/ zhun mar 'di zhag bdun par byin gyis brlab bo zhes dang*/ 'bras bu gsum sbyar ba'i sman 'di 'tsho ba'i bar du bcang bar byin gyis brlab bo zhes lan gsum dang*/ thabs legs so// rin po che byin gyis brlab pa ni gsum ste/ sbyin bdag bdag po nyid du mos su gzhug pa dang*/ zhal lta byed pa bdag po nyid du khas len du gzhug pa dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa'o// de'i sngags ni/ btsun pa nas zhes bgyi bas dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'di snyed de/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dngos po rung ba ma lags pa de rung ba sgrub par bgyi'o zhes lan gsum dang*/ thabs legs bya'o// 'di dag gi mtha' gcod rgyas pa ni/ las chog gi dka' 'grel legs par bshad pa'i ba dan dkar po'i rnga dbyangs kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba der bshad zin to// //dpal ldan zhi ba'i nags tshal stug po'i dbus// chos 'dul seng ge'i khri la gnas bcas nas// blo bzang ri dwags mang po skyong mkhas pa'i// 'jigs med ston pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// yon po'i lam du nam yang mi 'jug cing*// bslab gsum nan tan gom stabs drang po yis// 'od byed sa la bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa de// bstan pa'i lam chen gsal ba'i nyi ma yin// gnang bkag ma lus gsal ba sde bzhi'i lung*// lung don mtha' dag bsdus pa 'dul ba'i mdo// mdo rgyas gnyis kyis 'chad pa rgya cher 'grel// 'grel byed gzhan las lhag pa gang 'dir shes// thun mtshams li khri'i bla gos bgos bzhin du// yul 'khor bsod snyoms len pa'i gzhon nu dag

/yid 'ongs legs gsungs sil sil sgra sgrogs pa'i// lag len bsil byed bzang po 'di longs shig /chos 'dul nor bu'i bsil yab 'dzin bzhin du// lag len shel gyi khri la bsti byas nas// legs bshad 'dzum gyi phreng ba spro mkhas de// mtha' dag bstan pa'i rgyan cig ma lags sam// mkhas 'dod khur gyis ngal ba mang mod kyang*// chos 'dul ji bzhin shes pa'i mkhas pa su// sngon byung tshig gi ri mo bris tsam gyis// chos 'dul shes pa'i grangs su ga la 'gro// gzhi gsum ma chog bdud rtsi yi// rol mtsho mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs 'di// bstan la mi phyed dad pa can// sa skyong bkra shis nyin mo'i mgon// mched yum bcas pa'i 'byor pa yi// rgya mtsho don yod bya ba'i phyir// lhag bsam dkar bas bskrun pa yin// dge de'i bsil zer mdangs kyis ni/ bstan pa'i rgya mtsho bstan 'dzin gyi// ded dpon mang pos rab bkang nas// yid bzhin rol mtsho'i dpal gyur cig /ces gzhi gsum gyi tshig gsal bar byed pa'i bstan 'chos bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yul dbus kyi 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i dge slong dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyis rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta'i lo khrums kyis nya ba'i yar ngo'i 'grub sbyor bzang po la/ mnga' ris smad kyi sa'i thig le thub bstan dar rgyas gling gi gtsug lag khang chen por legs par sbyar ba'o// //'di yang*/ bya yul gyi sa'i thig le bkra shis chos 'khor lhun por/ chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i ched du/ gting khebs pa sde bdun dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyis/ par du bsgrubs te/ thub bstan gser mdog can phul ba'i dge bas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ thub bstan dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig bkra shis so// // ༄// na mo ratna tra yā ya/ khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du btang nas/

rten gsum gyi drung du/ bsnyen gnas len par 'dod pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ bsnyen gnas par bzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ yang sangs rgyas dang sogs/ dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las slar log par bgyi'o// yan lag dang po 'dis/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su sgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// gzhan yang 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ ma byin par len pa dang*/ mi tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ rdzun du smra ba dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba/ bag med pa'i gnas glu gar dang*/ rol mo'i sgra dang*/ phreng ba dang*/ spos myug pa dang*/ rgyan dang kha dog 'chang ba dang*/ khri stan mthon po dang*/ khri stan chen po dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i kha zas kyi spangs te/ de dag las slar log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ ma byin par len pa nas/ dus ma yin pa'i kha zas kyi bar spangs te/ de las slar log par bgyi'o// yan lag brgyad po 'dis/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi bslab pa la rjes su slob bo// rjes su sgrub bo// rjes su bgyid do// legs so// 'di dge slong gi drung ngam/ rten gsum gyi drung gang du len kyang*/

nyi ma ma shar ba'i gong kho nar len dgos la/ phan yon ni/ mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa dang*/ gnas skabs su lha'i dbang po'i go 'phang thob pa dang*/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa 'byang bar 'gyur ro// bsnyen gnas rang gi len pa'i cho ga'o// //swasti dzā ya/ gsung gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems pa'i sdom ni/ ngo bo nyid dang thams cad dang*// dka' ba dang ni sgo kun dang*// skyes bu dam pa ldan pa dang*// de bzhin rnam pa thams cad dang*// 'phongs shing 'dod dang ldan pa dang*// 'di dang gzhan du bde 'gyur dang*// rnam par dag dang rnam dgu ste// mdor na tshul khrims de yin no// pha rol las blangs bsam pa dag /mi nyams bya phyir gus bskyed cing*// dge dang dpag med phan 'dogs dang*// 'bras che yon tan bzhi ldan no// thams cad pa yang dngos dang po// len dang phyir gso mi mthun phyogs// dang po ngos bzung phun tshogs rgyu// ngos bzung ba ni rten gnyis kyis// sdom dang dge ba chos bsdud dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims kyis// legs bsdus dang po rigs bdun no// gnyis pa thos bsam sgom pa dang*// bla ma dang ni nad pa la// rim gro byed cing legs smra dang*// yon tan yon tan can la dga'// bzod dang bsngo dang smon lam 'debs// dkon mchog mchod dang de brgyad kyis// dge ba'i chos rnams bsgrub dang bsrung*// rnam par 'phel bar byed pa'o// gsum pa grogs byed rigs thabs ston// byas pa gzo dang 'jigs las bsrung*// mya ngan sel dang yo byad sgrub// bsdu dngos bzhi dang bcu gcig yin// phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu bshad bya// mi lta mi dga' zhen pa med// lus sems dben dang ngag yid dag /khyad du mi gsod dpe dang bzod// bag yod legs par bsdams pa ste// sdom tshul phun sum tshogs rgyu bcu// 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i longs spyod la// mi dga' 'dod lha'i dge ba la// mi blta da lta'i rnyed bkur la// lhag par zhen pa med pa'o// lus sems dben gnas ting nge 'dzin// mngon par sgrub dang dbang thob byed// dben dang 'du 'dzi'i nang dag tu'ang*// ngan pa'i gtam dang rtog pa ngan// dang du mi len byung ma thag

/dran pas 'dor bar byed pa'o// rlabs chen spyod la mi zhum pas// bdag nyid khyad du mi gsod cing*// ma rungs pa dang khrims 'chal la// snying brtse ba yis nges par byed// pha rol mtshon dang gzhug sogs kyi// gnod la ji mi snyam pas bzod// dus gsum snga dang lhan cig spyod// bag yod yan lag lnga ldan no// cho ga 'tsho ba rnam dag pas// legs par bsdams pa yin zhes bya// phyin drug mi mthun phyogs gyur pa// rnam pa lnga po yongs spangs nas// pha rol phyin drug bsdud pa ni// chos bsdud phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu// ser sna 'chal tshul khro sogs dang*// le lo snyoms las ro myang dang*// dge ba'i 'bras dang phan yon du// mthong dang dge ba'i rgyu tshol dang*// dge ba bsdud dang dge 'bras la// phyin ci log dang ma log dang*// dge la bar du gcod pa ste// shes rab 'chal ba lnga yin no// sems can don byed tshul khrims ni// phun sum tshogs rgyu gzhan ma bshad// sngar gyi bcu gcig de nyid ni// rgyas pa bshad pa de 'chad do// len sogs gsum ni nyi shu pa'i// gzhung bzhin 'dir yang dran par bya// de ltar byang chub sems dpa' ni// rang gi 'dul la bslab brtson pa// sbyor dang bsam pa sngon gyi rgyu// phun sum tshogs pa gsum ldan no// bzlog la 'phangs pa gsum zhes bya// rim bzhin sde dang sdug bsngal gnas// gsum pa dka' ba'i tshul khrims ni// spang dka' spang dang bsrung dka' bsrung*// brten dka' bag yod brten pa'o// yang dag sbyangs dang rang bzhin dang*// gso dang thabs ldan tshul khrims ni// tshul khrims thams cad pa yi sgo// rang nyid gnas shing gzhan la'ang 'god// bsngags pa brjod cing mthun la dga'// nyes pa byung na phyir 'chos pa// skyes bu dam pa'i tshul khrims so// rgya che kha na ma tho med// rab tu dga' ba'i gnas dang mthun// rgyun dang brtan dang rgyan dang ldan// 'jug dang ldog pa'i tshul khrims dang*// skyes chen mtshan dang ldan pa'i sems// sdug pa'i 'gro dang sems can don// smin byed tshul khrims bcu gsum ni// tshul khrims rnam pa thams cad pa// bdag la gnod pa'i mi dge ba// brgyad po byed pa gang yin pa// de ni bdag yid ma 'ong zhing*// bdag dang gzhan la de byed na// bdag gis kyang de 'phongs byas zhes// brnab sems log lta las gzhan brgyad// bsrung byed 'phongs pa'i tshul khrims so// gnang bkag ji bzhin byed pa dang*// bsdud dang tshar gcod lus ngag dag

/gzhan yang phyin drug ldan pa ste// dgu pa bde ba'i tshul khrims so// ha cang zhum dang thal ma yin// le lo med dang bag yod dang*// mi lta smon lam legs btab dang*// cho ga 'tsho ba phun tshogs dang*// nges par 'byin dang ma nyams pa// bcu po rnam dag tshul khrims bsdus// de ltar tshul khrims bsrung byas na// gnas skabs phan yon lnga thob cing*// mthar thug rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o// de ltar sde tshan dgu po yang*// tshul khrims gsum gyis bsdus pa ste// rten dang brten pa nyid dang ni// 'gro la phan 'dogs byed pa'o// byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi// ma mo tshul khrims le'u yi// 'chad thabs tshig ler byas 'di yang*// rgyal sras kun gyis yid 'ong shog /de skad 'di yang shākya yis// dge slong mchog ldan legs pa'i blos// sdom pa nyi shu'i kha skong du// bkod pas tshul khrims le'u'i don// ma lus rtogs shing bde blag du// rtogs par 'gyur ba 'di yin no// // ༄// na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ kha che bye brag smra ba ni// so thar sdom pa'i rtsa ba bzhi// gal te sna gcig 'chal gyur na// bu lon can dang nor can gyi// dpes mtshon khrims ldan khrims 'chal ba// gnyis ka yod do rtsa ltung de// sor tshud tshe na tshul khrims dang*// ldan pa kho nar dpe yis mtshon// rtsa ltung 'chab med chad pa'i las// ma blangs bar du khrims 'chal yang*// chad las bslab pa spyod bzhin pa// dge slong rnam dag nyid dang 'dra// 'chab med chad las khas mi len// gnas nas dbyung bya babs gyur pa// slar yang bsnyen par rdzogs ma thag /rnam par dag pa kho nar ni// nges so ci yi phyir zhe na// cho ga lung bzhin bgyis pa las// dge slong sdom pa khrims 'chal zhig /skye ba'i bshad pa med phyir ro// tshigs snga ma la byung ba yi// pham pa 'chab med da dung yang*// rgyud la ldan phyir sa gzhan du// gnas nas bslab pa spyod dgos so// pham pa 'chab med dang ldan pa'i// dge slong bslab pa phul gyur na// dge tshul dang ni dge bsnyen gyi// rtsa bzhi 'chal bar mi 'dod de// sdom gsum spong ba rdzas tha dad// gtong rgyu 'thob rgyu 'gal phyir dang*// gong ma phul yang 'og ma ni// brtan par gnas pa'i dpe de bzhin// dge tshul bslab pa spyod bzhin pa// bsnyen par rdzogs tshe dge slong gi

/spong ba rdzas gzhan rnam dag mod// pham 'dra'i nyes byas dag pa med// sa gzhan gnas kyang dge tshul gyis// tha mar 'os min bsnyen rdzogs phyir// dge slong rten la nyes med cing*// sa gzhan gnas pa ci zhe na// dge 'dun lhag ma 'chab bcas can// khyim par babs nas slar 'ongs bzhin// pham pa can la slar skye ba// lung dang 'gal bar nges zhe na// pham par byung yang babs pa'i tshe// legs par phul na slar skye ba// las kyi cho ga'i dgongs pa dang*// dge tshul pham 'dra'i nyes byas can// khyim par babs nas slar rdzogs pa// de de sa gzhan du gnas sam// gnas mi dgos zhes dpyad par bya// dge tshul pham 'dra'i nyes byas de// bsnyen par rdzogs pa 'gal zhe na// dge slong pham pa 'chab med can// babs nas rdzogs pa de bas 'gal// mi 'gal bye smra'i lugs she na// bslab rgyun phyi ma'i rten de la// bslab spyod mi dgos bye smra'i lugs// ci phyir zhe na 'chab med kyi// pham pa khyim pa'i rten la 'jig /'di ni kha che bye smra yi// dka' gnas dpyad tshul gnyis pa yin// pham pa 'chab med can 'ga' zhig /chad pa'i bslab la mi slob pa// de tshe gnas nas phyung gyur kyang*// sde snod 'dzin pa tshe yin na// slar yang gnas su bsdu byas te// sa gzhan gnas dgos ma yin par// shākya 'od mdzad kyis bshad do// de ltar 'phros pa'i don mang po// bsams nas dkyus ma 'dir bshad bya// 'chab bcas pham pa gcig gnyis gsum// byung ba'i dge slong khrims ldan des// 'chab sems snga mar 'gyod pa dang*// phyi ma sdom pa'i mthol bshags ni// tshad du long tshe 'chab sems kyis// dag par gyur nas de dus kyi// pham pa 'chab med du ldan pa// de 'dra bu lon kun gzhal nas// nor can kho nar gyur de bzhin// ci phyir zhe na 'chab med de// khrims 'chal 'chab bcas la ltos nas// dgos pa rnam drug sgrub nus pas// rtsa ba'i 'chab med de dang mnyam// 'chab sems pham pa las gzhan du// bshags par nus pa min zhe na// 'chab sems pham pa dngos gzhi yi// sbyor dang rjes su 'jug phyir dang*// sems kyi nyes pa kho na'i phyir// logs su bshad pa nus nyid do// 'o na 'chab nyes dang bral ba'i// 'chab med 'di dang dang po nas// 'chab med gyur pa'i khyad par ci// zhe na rang gi ngo bo ni// rig byed min pa'i gzugs nyid du// gnas la khyad par yod min yang*// dgos pa rnam drug mi 'grub par// sbyor dang rjes 'jug 'chab sems kyis// rang lus nyid du byas zin phyir// rgyu rkyen grogs kyi khyad par can// dngos gzhi'i dus su 'chab pa'i sems// dgos pa bye mdo rtsod pa'i gzhi// rtsa ba'i sdom pa gcig gtong bas// ngos skal sdom pa gcig gtong zhing*// gzhan kun dgos pa sgrub nus par// yod ces zer dang gcig btang bas// thams cad 'khrugs par gyur ces pa'i// lugs gnyis yod ces bod yul gyi// ṭī ka byed 'ga' zer mod kyi// mdo sde pa dang snga rabs pa'i// lugs yin zer na lugs der ltos// bye brag smra ba'i gzhung min par// mdzod kyi rtsa 'grel dag tu gsal// bye brag smra ba 'dul lung gi

/grub mtha' mngon pa'i gzhung dang sbyor// mdo sde pa rnams mngon pa yi// sde snod logs su mi gnas zer// slob dpon yon tan 'od mdzad kyi// gzhung 'di mdo sde pa yin zhes// mang po gsung zhing 'od ldan gzhung*// bye brag smra zhes 'chad mdzad do// zhes pa 'di ni dbyig gnyen zhabs// kha che bye smra'i gzhung 'chad par// shin tu dge mdzad 'dul ba yis// mdo lung rnams dang ci 'byor 'byor// byed par 'dod nas bsams bsams pa// yi ge mkhan pos bris bris pa// gzhung mang po la bltas bltas pa// mang pos bltas na shes shes 'dra// 'dra min byung na dpyod pa dang*// dang por 'di tsam ma brtags na// na tshod rgan yang yang yang du// mgo 'khor bas ni ngal ngal ba'i// brtsom pa pos ni 'di brtsams so// //shu bhaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
